availability: week end + 1 day; retrospective assumption, historical publication unverified

btc_projection.fees: sum(inputs)-sum(outputs), do not allocate as transferred value
btc_projection.missing_prevout: reject as unavailable, no zero fill
btc_projection.non_address_scripts: exclude entire transaction if any input/output cannot map to one address; count
btc_projection.rule: for each resolved address input amount a_i and output b_j: rational a_i*b_j/sum(inputs)

eth_filters.duplicates: reject duplicate transaction identity before filtering

event_universe: confirmed native top-level transfers only; no token logs/internal calls
parallel_edges: aggregate ordered pair: count and sum native value
partial_weeks: exclude with explicit missing-source intervals; never fabricate partial graphs

raw_units.BTC: integer satoshis; rational projection; /1e8 for features

self_loops: retain observed self transfers; GAT adds one self-neighbor
